name: smartsheet_list_sheets
description: List all Smartsheet sheets available to the signed-in user, with their IDs and names. This can include sheets across the whole organization the user can see, not just their own. Prefer smartsheet_list_my_sheets or smartsheet_list_favorite_sheets unless the full org-wide list is specifically needed.

name: smartsheet_list_my_sheets
description: List sheets in the signed-in user's own Home tab (owned by them or shared directly to them), the same set shown when they log into Smartsheet. Use this for "my sheets" style requests instead of smartsheet_list_sheets.

name: smartsheet_list_favorite_sheets
description: List sheets the signed-in user has starred as favorites in Smartsheet.

name: smartsheet_get_sheet
description: Read a sheet's columns and rows. Identify the sheet by sheetId or sheetName.

sheetName.description: Exact sheet name, used if sheetId is not given.

name: smartsheet_add_row
description: Add a new row to a sheet. Cells are keyed by column title, matching what smartsheet_get_sheet returns.

sheetName.description: Exact sheet name, used if sheetId is not given.

cells.description: Column title -> value for the new row. For CONTACT_LIST columns, use an email string or an object such as {"email":"person@example.com"}.

name: smartsheet_update_row
description: Update cells on an existing row. Cells are keyed by column title, matching what smartsheet_get_sheet returns.

sheetName.description: Exact sheet name, used if sheetId is not given.

rowId.description: ID of the row to update, from smartsheet_get_sheet.

cells.description: Column title -> new value. For CONTACT_LIST columns, use an email string or an object such as {"email":"person@example.com"}.

name: smartsheet_create_workspace
description: Create a new, empty Smartsheet workspace to hold sheets. Returns the new workspace ID.

name: smartsheet_create_sheet
description: Create a new sheet from a column definition, optionally inside a workspace. Each column needs a title and a type (TEXT_NUMBER, DATE, PICKLIST, CHECKBOX, or CONTACT_LIST). Exactly one column must be marked primary, must be of type TEXT_NUMBER, and must come first. For a PICKLIST column, include an "options" array of the allowed values.

workspaceId.description: Workspace to create the sheet in, if any.

workspaceName.description: Exact workspace name, used if workspaceId is not given.

columns.description: Column definitions, in left-to-right order. The primary column must come first.

name: smartsheet_list_discussions
description: Read the comment threads (discussions) on a sheet, or on one row of it. Give rowId to read a single row's conversation, omit it to read the whole sheet's. Returns each thread with its comments.

sheetName.description: Exact sheet name, used if sheetId is not given.

rowId.description: Row ID from smartsheet_get_sheet. Omit to read the whole sheet's discussions.

name: smartsheet_add_comment
description: Post a comment on a sheet, or on one row of it. This starts a new comment thread (Smartsheet calls it a discussion); it does not reply to an existing thread. On a row, the comment appears in that row's conversation pane in Smartsheet.

sheetName.description: Exact sheet name, used if sheetId is not given.

rowId.description: Row ID from smartsheet_get_sheet. Omit to comment on the sheet as a whole.

name: smartsheet_add_column
description: Add a new column to an existing sheet. Appends to the right unless index is given. For a PICKLIST column, include an "options" array of the allowed values.

sheetName.description: Exact sheet name, used if sheetId is not given.

index.description: Zero-based position. Omit to append to the right of the existing columns.

name: smartsheet_update_column
description: Rename, retype, reorder, or change the dropdown options of an existing column. Identify the column by its exact title or by columnId. Refuses to touch the primary column, system columns, and project/Gantt columns. Changing a column type converts every cell in it and clears its validation, so confirm with the user first.

sheetName.description: Exact sheet name, used if sheetId is not given.

columnTitle.description: Exact current title of the column to change.

columnId.description: Column ID, used instead of columnTitle when the title is ambiguous.

type.description: New column type. Converts existing cell values.

options.description: Replacement list of allowed values, for PICKLIST columns.

index.description: Zero-based position to move the column to.
